A1 - AI without the data centers.

Every other AI app ships your questions to a warehouse the size of a town — one that drinks water by the reservoir and burns power by the city — then rents the answer back to you by the month. A1 doesn't.

A1 runs two ways, and neither needs a data center:

• On your phone. A small, capable model runs fully on your device. Nothing is uploaded. No account.
• Across the mesh. Or borrow a slice of compute from a decentralized network of real people's devices — no headquarters, no landlord.

What you type never becomes someone's training pile. What you ask is never sold back to you. And not a single drop of water is boiled off to answer “hey.”

Common sense about thinking machines: a model is just math, and the chip in your pocket is enough to think with.

Ask anything. Run it on us, not on the planet.

• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

record.name: Hearit.AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Hearit.AI works with compatible Hearit.AI audio devices over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Use captured audio for AI conversations, translation, meeting transcription, notes, and text-to-speech.

Key features:
• Connect and manage compatible devices: discover devices, view connection status, battery, hardware model, firmware version, and update availability.
• AI conversations: send captured speech to AI and review responses in the app.
• Translation: translate captured speech across supported languages and optionally play translations aloud.
• Meeting transcription: record audio locally, keep WAV recordings and transcripts, upload selected recordings, track processing, review segments, and play related audio.
• Notes: save, edit, organize, and play supported note content.
• Voice playback: AI replies and translations can generate speech and play automatically. Automatic playback and background playback can be controlled in Settings.
• Account controls: manage sign-in methods, profile information, legal documents, and account deletion.

A compatible Hearit.AI device and an internet connection are required for device audio processing and AI features. Availability varies by device model, language, and network conditions.

Privacy Policy: https://api.hearit.ai/legal/privacy

record.description_evidence:
Read Aloud AI is your personal text-to-speech companion, letting you turn written content into realistic, easy-to-listen audio. Whether you're reading articles, studying for class, listening on the go, or just giving your eyes a break, our app makes it simple to convert text to high-quality spoken voice.



Powered by advanced neural speech synthesis, Read Aloud AI provides lifelike voices in multiple languages. Paste your own text or type on the fly — hit play and listen.



Turn text into natural-sounding speech with Read Aloud AI! Listen to articles, notes, emails, or any text on the go. Perfect for productivity, accessibility, and absorbing content effortlessly.




KEY FEATURES:



- High-Quality Voices: Choose from a selection of clear and natural text-to-speech (TTS) voices.

- Read Webpages Easily: Simply paste a URL (webpage link), and Read Aloud AI will fetch the main content and read it aloud for you. No more copy-pasting large blocks of text!

- Type or Paste Text: Input text directly or paste from your clipboard.

- Adjustable Speed: Control the playback rate (speed) to listen at your preferred pace (0.5x to 2.0x).

- Save & Manage Audio: Option to save the generated speech as audio files directly on your device. Access and replay your saved audio anytime.

- In-App Browser: Browse websites within the app and easily send selected text or the page URL to the text-to-speech engine.

- Clipboard Helper: Quickly paste content copied from other apps. Option to auto-play pasted text.

- iOS Shortcut Support: Integrate Read Aloud AI with the Shortcuts app on iOS for powerful automation workflows.

- Clean Interface: Simple, intuitive design with Light and Dark mode support.

- Help & Info: Convenient in-app guide to get you started and explain all features.



WHO IS THIS FOR?



- Students: Listen to lecture notes, research papers, and textbooks.

- Professionals: Catch up on emails, reports, and articles during commutes.

- Content Consumers: Listen to blog posts and news articles while multitasking.

- Accessibility Needs: Assists users with visual impairments or reading difficulties like dyslexia.

- Anyone who prefers listening over reading!



Download Read Aloud AI today and give your eyes a rest! Experience the convenience of having text read aloud anytime, anywhere.

record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Introducing Monogram — a new way to interact with AI. Unlike the AI assistants you are familiar with, Monogram is not a chatbot. Instead, it responds to any question you have with a visual and interactive answer — instantly.

Monogram AI is a free visual AI assistant that answers your questions with interactive screens instead of a wall of text. Ask anything, and in seconds Monogram AI builds a custom answer you can tap and explore: cards, photos, lists, side-by-side comparisons, videos, and step-by-step guides. It is completely free with unlimited use.

WHAT IS MONOGRAM AI?
Most AI apps are chatbots that reply in paragraphs, sometimes with a picture added. Monogram AI is not a chatbot. It designs a brand new interface for every question you ask. Ask "what should I watch tonight?" and get a movie guide with posters and trailers. Ask "plan a weekend in New York" and get a visual itinerary. Ask for a recipe and get a recipe card with ingredients and clear steps.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH MONOGRAM AI
• Pick a movie or show: get recommendations for movie night and watch trailers without leaving the app.
• Cook and bake: ask for any recipe, like "extra chewy chocolate chip cookies", and follow the steps.
• Plan a trip: use Monogram AI as your AI travel planner for a day-by-day itinerary with places to see.
• Find a restaurant: discover places to eat based on what you are craving.
• Compare before you buy: put electric cars, phones or headphones side by side.
• Plan events: organize a birthday party, a dinner or a weekend with friends.
• Generate images: create AI photos from a simple prompt, like "a pink flying Eiffel Tower".
• Turn any story into a comic: ask "Tell me the story of…" and get an animated, comic book-style story you can watch as a narrated video or save as a photo gallery.
• Write messages: draft and edit emails, invitations and texts, then copy them anywhere.
• Get math help: ask a math question and see the solution laid out visually.
• Follow sports: check game scores and results.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Ask any question in your own words.
2. Monogram AI designs a visual, interactive answer in seconds.
3. Tap to explore, go deeper, or share the page with friends.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE MONOGRAM AI
• Free and unlimited: ask as many questions as you want, no paywall and no daily limits.
• Visual answers are faster to scan and easier to understand than long text replies.
• Every answer is interactive, so you explore instead of scrolling.
• Share any page and download your comic stories.
• Find past answers anytime in your history on the home screen.
• Available in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German and Turkish.

WHO IS MONOGRAM AI FOR?
Anyone who wants clear, quick answers to everyday questions: travelers, home cooks, movie fans, parents planning a party, shoppers comparing products, students, and curious minds who would rather see an answer than read one.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is Monogram AI free?
Yes. Monogram AI is free to download and free to use, with unlimited questions.

Is Monogram AI a chatbot?
No. Monogram AI is an AI app with a visual interface. Instead of chat replies, it creates an interactive screen for each question.

Can Monogram AI generate images?
Yes. Describe what you want to see, and Monogram AI creates the image for you.

Can Monogram AI make comics and stories?
Yes. Ask "Tell me the story of…" to get a comic book-style story you can play as a narrated video and share.

Can I share my answers?
Yes. You can share any page with friends and family.

Download Monogram AI and ask anything for free.

record.name: Signa AI
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Signa AI turns everyday text, audio and speech into sign language, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Type or paste a sentence, record your voice, or upload an audio file and watch a clear avatar sign it back to you.

Built to make communication more accessible for the Deaf and hard-of-hearing community, Signa AI works in Kinyarwanda, French and English.

What you can do
• Type or paste text and see it signed
• Record your voice and have it transcribed, then signed
• Upload an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A) and get a signed version
• Watch a clean, easy-to-follow signing avatar
• Revisit your previous translations anytime in the History tab at no cost

Languages
Speak or type in Kinyarwanda, French or English, then choose your sign-language output: Kinyarwanda Sign Language, American Sign Language, French Sign Language or British Sign Language.

Signed output is powered by a research-backed pose model, and our coverage keeps improving.

Who it's for
• Schools and teachers caption lessons for Deaf students
• Creators and YouTubers add a signing avatar to your videos
• Broadcasters and organizations make announcements accessible
• Anyone who wants to connect with Deaf friends, family or customers

Signa AI is built by Xendly Labs in Kigali, Rwanda. Questions or feedback? Email [support@xendlylabs.com](mailto:support@xendlylabs.com) we'd love to hear from you.

record.description_evidence:
Vision Assistant is an accessibility-focused camera and voice assistant designed to help people who are visually impaired  better understand the world around them.

The app uses the camera to identify nearby objects, describe scenes, read visible text, and provide spoken guidance. Users can interact hands-free with voice commands, including asking for help whenever they need instructions.

Key features include:

• Spoken scene descriptions
• Object and direction guidance
• Text reading from the camera view
• Voice command support
• Audio-first onboarding and help instructions
• Large, clear controls designed for accessibility
• Haptic and speech feedback for easier navigation

Vision Assistant is designed to support everyday awareness, but it should not be used as a replacement for mobility tools, professional assistance, or personal judgment. Results may vary depending on lighting, camera visibility, network connection, and object clarity.

record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Visionauta is your portable visual assistant. Point your iPhone's camera to read text aloud, identify banknotes, find lost objects, or simply ask questions about the world around you. Built from the ground up for blind and low-vision users, with a free tier and an optional Visionauta Plus subscription. No Visionauta account is required to subscribe.

REAL-TIME CONVERSATION
Talk to an AI by voice, naturally and continuously, while it describes your surroundings and answers your questions instantly — as if a sighted assistant were right beside you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Read any text aloud, even offline
• Recognize banknotes in several currencies (Brazilian Real, US Dollar, Euro, Mexican Peso, Japanese Yen, Canadian and Australian Dollar)
• Find lost objects with voice commands
• Electronic magnifier with high-contrast modes
• Ask the AI assistant to describe scenes and answer questions

IN 39 LANGUAGES
Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, Korean, German, Italian, Japanese, Arabic, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese, Hindi, Indonesian, Bangla, Czech, Greek, Estonian, Persian, Finnish, Hebrew, Hungarian, Icelandic, Lithuanian, Marathi, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish, Swahili, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Cantonese. The interface, AI, commands, OCR and online voices adapt to your language. The on-device Natural Voice remains available in the five languages supported by its model.

BUILT FOR ACCESSIBILITY
Fully integrated with VoiceOver and the iPhone's accessibility features, so every function is reachable by touch and voice.

Visionauta was created by Jonathan Santos, a blind software engineer who worked at Google and Samsung, with one goal: to bring more independence to people with visual impairments. The free tier has no ads; Visionauta Plus is available as an optional in-app subscription.

Transform how you interact with the visual world around you. Clarity is designed specifically for people with visual impairments, offering four powerful features that work seamlessly together to enhance your daily independence and confidence.

Experience magnification like never before with our intelligent camera system. Our dynamic photo analysis technology delivers superior zoom quality that surpasses your phone's standard capabilities. See colors in vibrant detail with our groundbreaking colorblind accessibility feature. Using advanced color matrix technology, Clarity instantly transforms any image to accommodate different types of colorblindness including Deuteranopia, Protanopia, and Tritanopia. Simply snap a photo and watch as colors become more distinguishable and accessible. Perfect for reading color-coded information, enjoying photo memories with enhanced contrast, or navigating interfaces that rely on color differentiation. You can even customize the app's UI colors to match your specific colorblindness type for optimal usability.

Intelligent Text-to-Speech
Turn any text into clear, spoken words instantly. Our powerful OCR technology accurately extracts text from images, displays it in high-contrast format on your screen, and reads it aloud with fully customizable voice settings. Adjust the speaking speed and choose from multiple voice options to match your preferences. The recognized text can be edited, re-read, or copied for use in other apps, giving you complete control over how you interact with written information in your environment.

AI-Powered Image Understanding
Get instant answers about any image with our advanced machine learning technology. Whether you're trying to understand a blurry photo, decipher complex charts, or need detailed descriptions of your surroundings, simply ask questions about any image and receive accurate, helpful responses. Our cloud-based AI draws from an extensive knowledge database while protecting your privacy—no data is stored between sessions.

Easy-to-access tutorials guide you through each feature, ensuring you can maximize the app's potential regardless of your technological experience.

Built by a team that understands visual challenges firsthand, Clarity represents a new standard in accessibility technology. Every feature is crafted to integrate seamlessly into your daily life, providing the independence and confidence you deserve.

Download Clarity today and discover a world of enhanced visual accessibility at your fingertips.

record.name: Otto: Own Your AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Otto is the control surface for your AI agents.

Your agent runs on your own Otto device, not on rented cloud servers. The app is how you talk to it, see what it's doing, approve what matters, and stay in control of everything running on your behalf from anywhere.

CHAT WITH FULL VISIBILITY
Work with your agent in a conversation built for real tasks. Follow its reasoning as it works, see every tool call before it happens, and get a push notification the moment it needs a decision from you. Your agent asks before doing anything consequential. You approve or decline, and it picks up where it left off.

SEE EVERYTHING IT DOES
Live activity for running and completed tasks, agent logs, file browsing, and a remote shell when you want to get hands-on. Nothing happens off-screen.

ONE-TAP CONNECTIONS
Passkey links your agent to the services you already use. The app handles the sign-in flow on your phone, so your agent never has to juggle tokens or config files.

SPEND UNDER CONTROL
Gateway shows exactly what is being spent, by agent, by model, over time. Set per-agent limits and usage caps, and switch between cloud and on-device models.

RUN A FLEET
Manage multiple agents across multiple Otto devices from one place. Give each one its own identity, email, and phone number, and check in on any of them at any time.

SET UP BY TAPPING
Hold your phone to a new Otto to pair it over the local network. Wi-Fi setup, software updates, and device settings all live in the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
When you are away from home, the app reaches your device through Otto's encrypted relay. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, so there are no ports to forward, no VPN to configure, and nothing readable in between. Sign in with a passkey or with Apple.

REQUIRES AN OTTO DEVICE
Otto is the companion app for Otto hardware running Otto OS. An Otto device is required to set up and run an agent. Learn more at myotto.ai.

OmniAI allows you to chat with several advanced AI models from different providers in a single interface. Switch between models, compare responses, and choose the answer that works best for you.
 
Supported models include GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and DeepSeek-V2.
 
Why use OmniAI?
 
Compare responses
Ask a question once and view answers from different AI models to gain broader insight.
 
Switch instantly
Move between models seamlessly without leaving the app.
 
One clean interface
A focused chat experience designed for clarity, speed, and productivity.
 
Designed for productivity
Use OmniAI for writing, research, coding, brainstorming, translation, summarization, learning, and professional tasks.
 
Each AI model has unique strengths. Some perform well in reasoning, others in creativity or long-context understanding. OmniAI helps you access these capabilities in one place.
 
Who is it for?
 
Entrepreneurs and business professionals
Developers and engineers
Students and researchers
Writers and content creators
Anyone who wants access to multiple AI systems in one app

record.description_evidence:
The AI Advantage app is designed for professionals and business owners who want to use artificial intelligence practically and confidently in their daily work.

This is where clarity replaces confusion.

The app brings together the full AI Advantage experience in one structured environment, giving members a focused space to learn, implement, and connect without distraction.

Built for entrepreneurs, operators, and professionals, the AI Advantage app is designed to help you install AI systems that eliminate digital busywork, reclaim time, and strengthen your position in a rapidly evolving world.


Core Features:

Centralized Access
All of your AI Advantage content, programs, and community access are organized in one place. No switching platforms. No scattered resources. Just a clear path forward.

Structured Learning
Inside the “Courses” area you will access implementation-focused videos, frameworks, and step-by-step guidance designed to help you move from understanding AI to applying it in your real workflow.

Community Interaction
Connect with other professionals who are installing AI systems in their businesses and careers. Ask questions, share wins, and learn from real-world use cases in a moderated, focused environment.

Live Sessions & Events
Join live trainings, workshops, and virtual experiences directly through the app. Receive notifications so you stay aligned and never miss important updates.

Progress Tracking
Move through content at your own pace while maintaining momentum. The app helps you stay organized and continue building practical AI leverage over time.

Focused Communication
Receive updates, insights, and announcements inside the app without the noise of traditional social platforms. Stay informed without being overwhelmed.


Implementation Over Information

AI Advantage is built on the belief that AI should simplify your work, not complicate it. The goal is not to learn more tools. The goal is to install the right systems that save time and improve decisions.

This app supports that transition.

Download the AI Advantage app to access a structured environment where AI becomes practical, clear, and immediately usable in your business and career.
